interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up or use API Anything safely with a website. Check the available sites and operations first, and do not invent operations or endpoints.
interface.longDescription: A workflow companion for the open-source API Anything project. It guides setup and safe use of the local api-anything CLI and stdio MCP server. It does not host the project or create a remote endpoint.

name: api-anything
description: Use API Anything to learn and call website operations through its local CLI and MCP server.
